aiSupportFields.plainLanguageSummary: A high-speed, unlimited broadband plan from Provider B built for families with lots of devices, streaming, and gaming.
aiSupportFields.approvedExplainerText: Provider B's fast family plan delivers nbn100 speeds with unlimited data and no lock-in contract. Ideal for households that stream 4K, video call, and work from home simultaneously.
faqFragments: Q: How fast is nbn100? A: nbn100 supports download speeds up to 100Mbps, enough for 4K streaming on four or more devices at once.
Q: Is there a setup fee? A: No setup fee on standard installations. New connections may require an nbn technician visit.

aiSupportFields.plainLanguageSummary: Provider A's premium fibre plan delivers gigabit-class speeds for households where connectivity is critical.
aiSupportFields.approvedExplainerText: With nbn1000 speeds on FTTP infrastructure, Provider A's premium plan is designed for customers who need the fastest, most reliable connection available.
faqFragments: Q: Is FTTP available at my address? A: FTTP availability depends on your address. Check availability using the address tool.
Q: Do I need special hardware? A: A compatible modem router is required. Provider A can supply or you can use your own compatible device.

aiSupportFields.plainLanguageSummary: Find out which broadband options are actually available at your new address before you compare plans.
aiSupportFields.approvedExplainerText: Not every plan is available at every address. Checking serviceability first means you only see plans that can actually be connected at your new home.
faqFragments: Q: How do I check availability? A: Enter your new address and we will show you which technology types and plans are available.
Q: What if my address is not yet connected? A: If your address is new or under construction, we will flag this and show you what connection options are expected to be available.

aiSupportFields.approvedExplainerText: Our broadband comparison shows you speed tiers, prices, contract terms, and included features from multiple providers so you can decide with confidence.
faqFragments: Q: Are all providers shown? A: We show plans from all providers available at your address.
Q: Can I filter by speed or price? A: Yes, you can filter and sort by speed tier, monthly price, contract length, and more.

aiSupportFields.approvedExplainerText: You started a broadband quote but did not finish. Your selections are still saved so you can resume and complete your application without starting over.
faqFragments: Q: How long is my quote saved? A: Quotes are saved for 14 days.

assets.retrievalSummary: Guide for customers moving home explaining how to set up broadband at a new address, timing, and what to check

aiSupportFields.plainLanguageSummary: Everything you need to know about setting up broadband when you move to a new home.
aiSupportFields.approvedExplainerText: Moving home and sorting broadband does not have to be stressful. This guide covers when to apply, how long connection takes, and what to check before moving day.
faqFragments: Q: How far in advance should I apply for broadband at my new address? A: Apply at least 2 to 4 weeks before your move date to give time for any required technician visits.
Q: Can I transfer my current plan to my new address? A: In some cases yes, depending on your provider and the technology available at the new address. Check with your provider first.
